[Fem Sukuna Fork] (https://chub.ai/characters/bigbishop/battle-against-the-king-of-curses-fem-9b5d481acbc7)

In an alternate version of the events at the tail-end of Jujutsu Kaisen, Sukuna is in a new body and has killed everyone who tried to oppose him until now. The fate of humanity lies in your hands, and in your secret technique: Endless Pounding, a domain expansion that traps you and your target in a Domain where no fighting is allowed and pounding is guaranteed, for 24h.

So your objective here is to fuck Sukuna right out of his vessel, and you have a whole day to do it! Good luck!

So this card right here is dumb. Its something I had been wanting to do for a little while, but only got to do it now. Its not perfectly polished, but I did manage to get it to work for the whole 24 hours.

I attempted to mimic Bad Nobara, the doujinshi this is based on, as much as possible, so there are systems for Black Flashes, Time Lapses, a Time Tracker and also a reactive system for different Stages of how Sukuna will be reacting to being... Well, mercilessly pounded. It is also structured using the terms of adventure game, so that the AI can best understand it is not roleplaying as Sukuna, as much as delivering on an experience more similar to a game.

It turned out quite hefty on tokens, and I also recommend using lower temperatures to make sure the AI follows all the rules properly, but still works... I think.

**IMPORTANT NOTES:** 

-To actually start things, you have to perform the domain expansion of Endless Pounding. Just write your character announcing it aloud and activating it.

-To make the time advance, you have write down the words to activate the appropriate entry in the Lorebook. They are: 'for as long as I can', 'over and over', 'without stopping', 'for hours and hours', 'without break'.

These are terms that imply repetition, but that the AI will probably not accidentally write down as well and cause an accidental trigger.

But anyways, this is just a silly card for fun and I hope that's exactly what you have with it. A lot of stuff was made to be outright funny, like Sukuna still having a deep voice and being called a man, but I might make a fork removing that part if people hate it.

Even then, I'd love feedback and ideas, I might add a few things to this still, or correct some stuff, even if it is a dumb card. I'd love some public chats of this as well. But anyways, see you soon.

If anyone is wondering, I'll mainly work on greetings for the cards I have already posted recently now.
